{{Top}}
'''Rogue Ten''' was the callsign used by certain fighter pilots of [[Rogue Squadron/Legends|Rogue Squadron]].

The pilots who have used the callsign include:
*[[Tarrin Datch/Legends|Tarrin Datch]] ([[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]])<ref name="GG3">[[Galaxy Guide 3: The Empire Strikes Back (Second Edition)|''Galaxy Guide 3: The Empire Strikes Back'', Second Edition]]</ref>
*[[Dar Keyis]] ([[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]])
*[[Soontir Fel/Legends|Soontir Fel]] ([[5 ABY/Legends|5 ABY]])<ref name="XWRS:MR">[[X-Wing Rogue Squadron 35|''X-Wing Rogue Squadron'' 35]]</ref>
*[[Ooryl Qrygg]] ([[6 ABY/Legends|6.5]]&ndash;[[11 ABY/Legends|11 ABY]])<ref name="XW:RS">''[[X-Wing: Rogue Squadron]]''</ref><ref name="IJ">''[[I, Jedi]]''</ref>
